identity_rule.tokens: Split displayed source-spelling field on whitespace. Preserve all spellings and case in saved text. The one displayed vertical bar in each verse is recorded separately as database notation.
identity_rule.case_sensitive: No character normalization beyond HTML entity decoding and display-whitespace collapse.
identity_rule.casefold: Only casefold per word; no spelling normalization, stemming, edit distance, omitted word or reordered word.
identity_rule.comparison_population: The single complete source-spelling base field 444239 only.

bounded_observations: All three different complete terminal cues occur uniquely and strictly internally in the complete base under the declared casefold rule; their starts are in ascending order.
Ite obviam and Ostende match the base case-sensitively; Qui regnas does not because the base has qui regnas. Thus a claim of three byte-exact identities would be false.
Each standardized-spelling verse field omits its terminal cue. Standardized fields cannot replace the source-spelling fields for this observation.
The four entries are consecutive in the displayed institutional source navigation: 003v sequence8 then004r sequences1,2,3. This is record adjacency, not an observed four-paragraph layout.
interpretation_and_open_limits: Different terminal cues selecting three different internal starts is supported as a text-retrieval interpretation by the indexed responsory/verse sequence; the literal identity observation itself does not prove every performance instruction.
No continuation endpoint, doxology, stopping at the next cue, or automatic continuation to the end is inferred from these four records.
The vertical bar is attested only in the database source-spelling field. No physical manuscript bar, paragraph mark, blank size or word-space geometry was inspected.
Historical witness and transcription do not identify Voynich contents, language, word meanings, word/group alignment, paragraph ownership, music or a native retrieval operation.
This verifies the existing raw901 historical example; it does not claim a new writing mechanism or select a native experiment.
